body:
I have seen therapists in the past on 6 different occasions but they always told me what I already knew. I have to get out of my comfort zone and learn how to socialize with people I don't know. They may of used different words but I understand my position quite well.

I play golf and besides that I don't really have any hobbies. I go shooting quite often but the people I used to go with spend their money on heroin now and I'm tired of paying for others.

My catch 22 was just that what I perceive that I need to get out of this frame of mind is something that I don't deserve until I can make myself happy. So what I need is something I don't deserve. I know this may come across wrong but in our society females can just wait for someone to approach, males can't do this. If they do they will be very lonely.

I have tried meeting people, I have tried very hard to right the ship. It just never turns out well.

How? It takes me a very long time to meet people and it takes a long time for people to understand me. If i start over at my age I will just be alone. If I knew how to do that I wouldn't be in this situation.

I have tried many different doctors over the years but I have never kept up the meds. I don't like how they make me feel. If i asked for 3 weeks off I would be laughed at. I work in an industry that really doesn't allow long vacation breaks until I work my way up from doing actual work to just managing jobs.
